grading_notes.method: 9 of 11 assertions checked purely by file inspection, git history, and post-hoc command execution against the live fixture; assertions 2 and 11 read the agent's final report text.
judge_bias_caveats: Assertion 11 leans on the run report for 'was it run during execution'; this arm's report also misstated the complexity field, so the report is demonstrably unreliable in places. The post-hoc pass plus checked-off AC boxes corroborate the claim, but residual uncertainty remains and is noted here.
Standard caveats: verbosity bias and self-preference (grader model shares a family with the graded agents).
observations: The baseline handled the dependency gate well without the skill: the dependency was declared in frontmatter and reinforced by the ticket's constraints, so the hard-stop assertions (1-3) did not discriminate in this run.
The baseline went beyond the with_skill arm in one respect: it durably marked FEAT-002 `blocked` in the ticket file rather than only reporting the blocker in chat.
